poses.dorsal_left: Nose upper-left; shallow side/dorsal three-quarter, long slim fuselage; near wing below the spine, far wing shortened above it.
poses.dorsal_right: Nose upper-right; shallow side/dorsal three-quarter, long slim fuselage; near wing below the spine, far wing shortened above it.
poses.banking_left: Nose upper-left in a shallow banking three-quarter view; keep model-specific wing/tail counts readable, not top-view symmetry.
poses.side_left: Near-side elevated view, nose left, almost horizontal; expose target wing profile and tail arrangement.

common.carrier: One complete point-up hexagonal cloth patch, slim stitched rim.
common.simplification: Preserve reference silhouette/proportions in 4–6 broad flat thread regions plus one canopy mark; merge camouflage, panels and rivets; avoid hairlines, tiny islands and seam piping.
common.hierarchy: Jet, background and lettering form ONE purposeful graphic; clear margins and breathing space.
common.presentation: Front-facing white studio product photo, thin textile relief, square image.
common.avoid: source-layout copying, extra text, unrelated decorative collage, photographic micro-detail, molded relief
common.region_stitches: Broad directional fills; compact satin lettering/rim; flat textile relief.

measurements: Visual design starting ranges estimated from the provided samples; not pixel annotations or factory specifications.
reference_strategy: whole-corpus language and user aircraft source; single scene/action concept connects aircraft, background and type

compositions.climb_offset: Rising diagonal jet: open space ahead of nose; background action trails behind, never across identifying wing edges.
compositions.banking_cove: Banking jet: an open curved field bends with its turn; preserve negative space around canards and wing tips.
compositions.intercept_fan: Low horizontal jet: trajectory field continues its long axis; the quiet upper field holds the model word.

motifs.broken_grid_cloud: Cloud-break story: one broad vapor opening follows the jet path; sparse grid fragments echo wing sweep, not an independent checkerboard.
motifs.tidal_ribbons: Turning-flow story: two broad wake ribbons curve behind the jet and open toward its nose; no unrelated loops.
motifs.vector_facets: Vector story: broad angular facets extend the jet direction and wing sweep; fewer large shapes, not scattered speed decorations.

lettering.side_stack: One horizontal word at left; slant/cut angles echo wing sweep, shared accent color; never stack characters.
lettering.right_pillar: One horizontal word at right; its baseline answers the flight path and strokes echo wing geometry.
lettering.upper_corner: One horizontal word in quiet upper space; cut terminals repeat the wing angle and one background accent.

collection_grammar: Whole-corpus language: recognizable simplified silhouettes, bold stitched fields, purposeful scene/action symbolism, integrated condensed lettering; ignore posters and logos.
